updates.background_zh: OCC 是美国历史最悠久的银行监管机构，成立于 1863 年，负责执行《国家银行法》并监管全国银行体系。OCC 授予的全国性银行牌照允许机构在单一联邦监管下于全国范围运营，免于各州分散法规的限制。数字资产托管指对加密私钥和数字资产进行安全存储和管理，长期以来，机构级托管的缺乏被认为是限制机构投资者参与加密市场的障碍之一。
updates.background_en: The OCC is the oldest US banking regulator, established in 1863 to administer the National Bank Act and oversee the national banking system. A national bank charter, granted by the OCC, allows an institution to operate nationwide under a single federal supervisor, preempting a patchwork of state laws. Digital asset custody refers to the secure storage and management of cryptographic keys and digital assets, and the lack of institutional-grade custody has long been cited as a barrier limiting institutional participation in crypto markets.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这一初步批准可能扩大面向加密企业和机构的受监管银行基础设施，降低对 FDIC 保险合作银行的依赖，并将稳定币托管与支付纳入联邦银行渠道。但实际市场传导取决于最终牌照获批及后续产品上线，因此不应推断任何方向性的价格影响。
updates.market_impact_en: This preliminary approval could expand the regulated banking infrastructure available to crypto firms and institutions, potentially lowering reliance on FDIC-insured partner banks and bringing stablecoin custody and payments onto federal banking rails. Actual market transmission, however, depends on final charter approval and subsequent product launches, so no directional price impact should be inferred.
